mapper.sql: kfs01_remote_view_id AS remote_view_id, kfs01_person_nm AS person_name, kfs01_date AS date, kfs01_start_time AS start_time, kfs01_close_time AS close_time, kfs01_reason AS reason, kfs01_manager_yn AS manager_yn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kfs01_remote_view SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personName}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{closeTime}, null, null, 'false'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kfs01_remote_view WHERE kfs01_remote_view_id IN ( SELECT sub.kfs01_remote_view_id FROM ( SELECT kfs01_remote_view_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY kfs01_person_nm, kfs01_date, kfs01_start_time ORDER BY kfs01_remote_view_id) AS row_num FROM kfs01_remote_view ) AS sub WHERE row_num > 1 )
